🌍 TELL YOUR NETWORK | SHAPE THE FUTURE OF GLOBAL JUSTICE
Share this article with your professional network and join the global conversation on redefining how we measure success in Online Dispute Resolution.
The future of ODR must go beyond settlement rates. It must measure fairness, efficiency, compliance, user experience, relationship preservation and lasting impact.
Let's move the conversation from counting settlements to creating meaningful, sustainable resolutions.
Your voice, insights and participation can help shape the next generation of global dispute resolution.
Read. Reflect. Share. Lead the Change.
comment: One practical challenge is ensuring that efficiency metrics don't disadvantage complex disputes. A fair resolution may take longer, especially when rebuilding trust or preserving ongoing relationships.
